auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Run your Instagram operations from one place.

workspaces.none: You do not have a workspace yet.

banner.simulationDetail: This workspace is simulated; nothing is sent to real Instagram.

empty.comingLater: This section arrives in a later phase
empty.comingLaterHint: For now the basic structure of your workspace is in place.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Choose the interface language. Your choice is saved to your account.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: The page or workspace you are looking for was not found.

INVALID_CREDENTIALS.next: Check your details and try again.

CSRF_FAILED.next: Reload the page and try again.

FORBIDDEN.next: Ask the workspace owner for help.

NOT_FOUND.what: We could not find what you were looking for.
NOT_FOUND.next: Check the address or go back to the home page.

CONFLICT_STATE.what: This action is not possible in the current state.
CONFLICT_STATE.next: Reload the page and try again.

INTERNAL_ERROR.next: Try again. If it keeps happening, share the request ID.

NETWORK_ERROR.what: The server could not be reached.
NETWORK_ERROR.next: Check your connection and try again.
